scope: W5 V33 original frozen 710-shard non-economic parity and subsequent valid per-seed evidence
work_loop: READ exact current live scientific pointer and current Git evidence index on branch; independently verify referenced immutable blob SHA1 and manifest SHA256
RECONSTRUCT Git snapshot bytes from native ZIP Git object or 16 separately hashed ASCII transport parts; do not consult ChatGPT Library to recover a published checkpoint
VERIFY old 446 frozen receipts and every existing Git delta (Merkle-like SHA256 parent chain), original plan/runner/root and closed gates
RUN one existing frozen task group only; at most six new original independent parity shards per publication. Do not repeat any task whose receipt SHA is already in Git

INDEPENDENTLY VALIDATE six actual new parity receipts against real original V28 tapes, then use the pure-Python github-shard-store validator to build an immutable SHA-pinned delta containing the complete JSON bytes of these receipts
UPLOAD delta text as Git blob; read back byte-identical content, compare Git blob SHA1 and SHA256; immutably commit Git blob path plus new Git-only index with parent hash and next cursor
COMPARE-AND-SWAP live scientific pointer with exact previous blob SHA; verify new pointer, target/anchor and Git delta readback before treating the six shards as closed
CONTINUE only after durable Git commit and pointer readback. On any error, preserve unpromoted local data and freeze without duplicating closed scientific work

storage.source_archive_exception: Original 2018-2019 broker tick carriers are too large for ordinary Git objects; keep original external archive bytes with exact SHA pins, never claim raw tick bytes were moved to Git
storage.chat_library: NOT_A_DURABLE_CHECKPOINT_STORE_FROM_THIS_RELEASE; only an ephemeral transfer bridge if native container-to-GitHub connector byte transfer is unavailable, delete bridge after Git byte readback

execution_limit: This policy is executed during active ChatGPT messages with GitHub connector access. Neither GitHub commits nor chat policies can run a process after the response ends.
